title: On a width-2 path, one interior has boundary-order half-bandwidth 3 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- On an equal-weight path of bandwidth 2, survivors kept in increasing index have Schur half-bandwidth 3 after an interior of length 2, 4, or 6 is deleted.
- The farthest new entries are `-1/504`, `-1/1664`, and `-121/887692`. Their original-index spans are 5, 7, and 9. The vertex outside each separator acquires no cross fill.
- Selected κ is unchanged. This does not measure width 3 or a truncated Gaussian row.

## Test plan
